# Entity

[API index](../index)

A live entity handle. The generated value-handle contract owns JS identity and stale-handle
recovery; this facade owns only typed reads over the currently resolved Rust entity.

```typescript
IsValid: boolean;
```

## HasIconOverhead

```typescript
HasIconOverhead: boolean | null;
```

NPC overhead marker: a reason to talk, not proof that a reward is available.
Null for non-NPC entities, unreadable memory, or an unavailable handle.

## CharacterClass

```typescript
readonly CharacterClass: CharacterClassInfo | null;
```

Current class and selected ascendancy, or null when the component or required records are unavailable.
Ascendancy is null only when the character is known to have none selected. Compare Id with
CharacterClass or Ascendancy constants; Name is display text. Read inside conditions to refresh.

**@keywords**

character, class, ascendancy, build, condition, specialization

Grid-space distance to the player, matching query radii and EC2 DistancePlayer.
Returns null when the entity or player cannot be resolved.

**@keywords**

distance, grid, radius, player, reagent

## WorldDistance

```typescript
WorldDistance: number | null;
```

World-space three-dimensional distance to the player. Query radii use grid units instead.
Returns null when either position is unavailable.

**@keywords**

distance, world, position, player
